subject: Scientific Instruments Change - Eastern Shore - Halifax Approaches
text:
Scientific Instruments Change - Eastern Shore - Halifax Approaches
Wave Glider C34167NS is remotely offloading data from bottom-mounted Innovasea VR4-UWM acoustic receivers located along polyline:
44 13.150N 063 14.612W
44 18.631N 063 20.779W
Wave glider C34167NS is copper in colour with a mast extending 1.2 metres above the surface of the water, supporting a solid white light and orange visibility flag and is equipped with a non-transmitting ais receiver. It is remotely operated, moving at a speed of approximately 1.2 knots and measuring 3.05 metres by 0.81 metres.
For further information, authorities and mariners may contact Sue L’Orsa at 250-877-8052, Tyler Byrne at 902-719-7078, or Liquid Robotics Wave Glider Operations Centre at +1 888-574-4574 or 408-636-4205.
